get_me.title: Get my profile
get_me.description: Return the authenticated Cal.com user: id, username, email, name, time zone, week start, time format, default schedule id, locale, avatar, bio and organizationId (null outside an organization). Start here to learn the user's id and organization id.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get my profile.

update_me.title: Update my profile
update_me.description: Update the authenticated user's profile: name, email, time zone, week start, time format, default schedule, locale, avatar URL, bio or metadata. Only the fields sent change. An email change needs verification before it becomes the primary email.

time_zone.description: Time zone.

avatar_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image

metadata.description: You can store any additional data you want here. Metadata must have at most 50 keys, each key up to 40 characters, and values up to 500 characters.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Update my profile.

get_my_booking_limits.title: Get my booking limits
get_my_booking_limits.description: Return the authenticated user's global booking limits (perDay, perWeek, perMonth, perYear; unset bounds are null). Only available to organization members; other accounts get 403.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get my booking limits.

update_my_booking_limits.title: Update my booking limits
update_my_booking_limits.description: Partially update the authenticated user's global booking limits. Only the intervals sent change; send null to remove one. Use clear_my_booking_limits to remove them all. Organization members only.

per_day.description: Maximum number of bookings per day. Pass null to remove this limit.

per_week.description: Maximum number of bookings per week. Pass null to remove this limit.

per_month.description: Maximum number of bookings per month. Pass null to remove this limit.

per_year.description: Maximum number of bookings per year. Pass null to remove this limit.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Update my booking limits.

clear_my_booking_limits.title: Clear my booking limits
clear_my_booking_limits.description: Remove every global booking limit of the authenticated user (per day, week, month and year). Organization members only. Use update_my_booking_limits to change a single interval instead.

output.description: The response body (status and, when present, data).

list_my_out_of_office.title: Get all out-of-office entries for the authenticated user
list_my_out_of_office.description: List the authenticated user's out-of-office entries with start, end, reason, notes and the user bookings are redirected to (toUserId). Paginate with take/skip; sort by start or end.

take.description: Maximum number of items to return

sort_start.description: Sort results by their start time in ascending or descending order.

sort_end.description: Sort results by their end time in ascending or descending order.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get all out-of-office entries for the authenticated user.

create_my_out_of_office.title: Create an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user
create_my_out_of_office.description: Create an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user between start and end, optionally with a reason, notes and a user (toUserId) to redirect booking requests to. Returns the created entry.

start.description: The start date and time of the out of office period in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

end.description: The end date and time of the out of office period in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

notes.description: Optional notes for the out of office entry.

to_user_id.description: The ID of the user covering for the out of office period, if applicable.

reason.description: the reason for the out of office entry, if applicable

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Create an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user.

update_my_out_of_office.title: Update an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user
update_my_out_of_office.description: Update one of the authenticated user's out-of-office entries: dates, reason, notes or redirect user. Only the fields sent change. Get ids from list_my_out_of_office.

ooo_id.description: Out-of-office entry id, from the matching out-of-office listing tool.

start.description: The start date and time of the out of office period in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

end.description: The end date and time of the out of office period in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

notes.description: Optional notes for the out of office entry.

to_user_id.description: The ID of the user covering for the out of office period, if applicable.

reason.description: the reason for the out of office entry, if applicable

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Update an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user.

delete_my_out_of_office.title: Delete an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user
delete_my_out_of_office.description: Delete one of the authenticated user's out-of-office entries by id. Returns the deleted entry. Get ids from list_my_out_of_office.

ooo_id.description: Out-of-office entry id, from the matching out-of-office listing tool.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Delete an out-of-office entry for the authenticated user.

create_booking.title: Create a booking
create_booking.description: Book a meeting on an event type: regular, recurring (event type with recurrence; pass recurrenceCount) or instant (team event with instant meetings). Identify the event type by eventTypeId, or eventTypeSlug plus username / teamSlug (and organizationSlug). `start` is a UTC ISO 8601 time taken from get_available_slots; `attendee` holds name, email, timeZone. Returns the booking (an array for recurring bookings).

start.description: The start time of the booking in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

attendee.description: The attendee's details. Fields: name*, timeZone*, phoneNumber, language, email (* = required).

booking_fields_responses.description: Booking field responses consisting of an object with booking field slug as keys and user response as values for custom booking fields added by you.

lead_enrichment_opt_out.description: The booker's answer to the lead enrichment opt-out, for an event type with a workflow that looks bookers up with lead enrichment. Send `true` when the booker ticked the opt-out and `false` when they were shown it and left it unticked. Sending `false` asserts that the booker saw the opt-out. Leave it out when the booker was not shown it: a booking without an answer is never looked up.

event_type_id.description: The ID of the event type that is booked. Required unless eventTypeSlug and username are provided as an alternative to identifying the event type.

event_type_slug.description: The slug of the event type. Required along with username / teamSlug and optionally organizationSlug if eventTypeId is not provided.

username.description: The username of the event owner. Required along with eventTypeSlug and optionally organizationSlug if eventTypeId is not provided.

team_slug.description: Team slug for team that owns event type for which slots are fetched. Required along with eventTypeSlug and optionally organizationSlug if the team is part of organization

organization_slug.description: The organization slug. Optional, only used when booking with eventTypeSlug + username, eventTypeSlug + teamSlug, or usernames.

usernames.description: Usernames of the hosts for a dynamic group booking (no stored event type) - every listed user must be available. Must contain 2 to 20 distinct usernames, and can't be combined with eventTypeId, eventTypeSlug, username or teamSlug. Pass organizationSlug when the users belong to an organization; without it only users outside any organization are found.

guests.description: An optional list of guest emails attending the event.

meeting_url.description: Deprecated - use 'location' instead. Meeting URL just for this booking. Displayed in email and calendar event. If not provided then cal video link will be generated.

location.description: One of the event type locations. If instead of passing one of the location objects as required by schema you are still passing a string please use an object. Fields: type*, address*, location*, phone*, integration* (* = required).

metadata.description: You can store any additional data you want here. Metadata must have at most 50 keys, each key up to 40 characters, and string values up to 500 characters.

length_in_minutes.description: If it is an event type that has multiple possible lengths that attendee can pick from, you can pass the desired booking length here. If not provided then event type default length will be used for the booking.

routing.description: Routing information from routing forms that determined the booking assignment. Both responseId and teamMemberIds are required if provided. Fields: queuedResponseId, responseId, teamMemberIds*, teamMemberEmail, skipContactOwner, crmAppSlug, crmOwnerRecordType, crmRecordOwnerFallbackTeamMemberIds, crmRecordOwnerFallbackMode (* = required).

email_verification_code.description: Email verification code required when event type has email verification enabled.

allow_conflicts.description: When true, availability conflict checks are bypassed for an authenticated user who has access through the existing event owner, host, assigned user, team admin or organization admin checks. Team- and organization-scoped keys are restricted to events in their stored team or organization. Otherwise this parameter is silently ignored. Only supported on the 2026-02-25 and 2026-05-01 API versions.

allow_booking_out_of_bounds.description: When true, booking time out-of-bounds checks are bypassed, allowing bookings outside the normally permitted scheduling window, for an authenticated user who has access through the existing event owner, host, assigned user, team admin or organization admin checks. Team- and organization-scoped keys are restricted to events in their stored team or organization. Otherwise this parameter is silently ignored.

skip_booking_limits.description: When true, booking limit checks (event type, team, and per-host count and duration limits) are bypassed for an authenticated user who has access through the existing event owner, host, assigned user, team admin or organization admin checks. Team- and organization-scoped keys are restricted to events in their stored team or organization. Otherwise this parameter is silently ignored. Only supported on the 2026-02-25 and 2026-05-01 API versions.

instant.description: Flag indicating if the booking is an instant booking. Only available for team events.

recurrence_count.description: The number of recurrences. If not provided then event type recurrence count will be used. Can't be more than event type recurrence count

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Create a booking.

list_bookings.title: Get all bookings
list_bookings.description: List bookings the authenticated user hosts or attends, cursor-paginated. Filter by a single status (upcoming, recurring, past, cancelled, unconfirmed), attendee email/name, booking uid, event type, team and start/end/created/updated date ranges; sort by start, end, created or updated. Returns `data` plus `pagination` (pass pagination.nextCursor back as cursor).

status.description: Filter bookings by a single status. Pass one (e.g. `?status=upcoming`) or omit to walk all statuses ordered by `Booking.uuid DESC`. To list bookings across multiple statuses, issue parallel requests, one per status.

attendee_email.description: Filter bookings by the attendee's email address.

attendee_name.description: Filter bookings by the attendee's name.

booking_uid.description: Filter bookings by the booking Uid.

event_type_ids.description: Filter bookings by event type ids. Event type ids must be separated by a comma.

event_type_id.description: Filter bookings by event type id.

teams_ids.description: Filter bookings by team ids that user is part of. Team ids must be separated by a comma.

team_id.description: Filter bookings by team id that user is part of

after_start.description: Filter bookings with start after this date string.

before_end.description: Filter bookings with end before this date string.

after_created_at.description: Filter bookings that have been created after this date string.

before_created_at.description: Filter bookings that have been created before this date string.

after_updated_at.description: Filter bookings that have been updated after this date string.

before_updated_at.description: Filter bookings that have been updated before this date string.

sort_start.description: Sort results by their start time in ascending or descending order.

sort_end.description: Sort results by their end time in ascending or descending order.

sort_created.description: Sort results by their creation time (when booking was made) in ascending or descending order.

sort_updated_at.description: Sort results by their updated time (for example when booking status changes) in ascending or descending order.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for cursor-based pagination. Pass the `pagination.nextCursor` value from a previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to fetch the first page.

limit.description: The number of items to return

output.description: The response envelope: `data` plus `pagination` (pass pagination.nextCursor back as cursor where the endpoint is cursor-paginated).

get_booking_by_seat.title: Get a booking by seat UID
get_booking_by_seat.description: Get a seated booking by one of its seat uids. Returns the parent booking with its attendees; a cancelled seat still resolves. Use get_booking when you have the booking uid itself.

seat_uid.description: Seat uid of a seated booking attendee.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get a booking by seat UID.

get_booking.title: Get a booking
get_booking.description: Get one booking by uid: status, start/end, title, event type, hosts, attendees, guests, location, meeting URL, booking field responses, cancellation/reschedule details and metadata. The uid of a recurring booking returns all of its recurrences.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get a booking.

get_booking_recordings.title: Get all the recordings for the booking
get_booking_recordings.description: List the Cal Video recordings of a booking with their download links. Only the organizer, hosts and team/org members allowed to read recordings can call it. Use get_booking_transcripts for transcripts.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get all the recordings for the booking.

get_booking_transcripts.title: Get Cal Video real time transcript download links for the booking
get_booking_transcripts.description: List download links for the Cal Video real-time transcripts of a booking. Only the organizer, hosts and team/org members allowed to read recordings can call it.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get Cal Video real time transcript download links for the booking.

reschedule_booking.title: Reschedule a booking
reschedule_booking.description: Move a booking to a new start time (UTC ISO 8601, from get_available_slots). Works on accepted and pending bookings; for a seated booking pass seatUid to move just that seat. Returns the new booking, whose uid differs from the old one.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

start.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format for the new booking

length_in_minutes.description: If the event type has multiple possible lengths, you can pass the new booking length here. If not provided then the original booking length is kept.

rescheduled_by.description: Email of the person who is rescheduling the booking - only needed when rescheduling a booking that requires a confirmation. If event type owner email is provided then rescheduled booking will be automatically confirmed. If attendee email or no email is passed then the event type owner will have to confirm the rescheduled booking.

email_verification_code.description: Email verification code required when event type has email verification enabled.

reschedule_with_same_host.description: Only for round robin event types that let the person rescheduling choose the host. True keeps the original host, false lets round robin pick from the whole team. Ignored for every other event type.

allow_conflicts.description: When true, availability conflict checks are bypassed for an authenticated user who has access through the existing event owner, host, assigned user, team admin or organization admin checks. Team- and organization-scoped keys are restricted to events in their stored team or organization. Otherwise this parameter is silently ignored. Only supported on the 2026-02-25 and 2026-05-01 API versions.

allow_booking_out_of_bounds.description: When true, booking time out-of-bounds checks are bypassed, allowing bookings outside the normally permitted scheduling window, for an authenticated user who has access through the existing event owner, host, assigned user, team admin or organization admin checks. Team- and organization-scoped keys are restricted to events in their stored team or organization. Otherwise this parameter is silently ignored.

skip_booking_limits.description: When true, booking limit checks (event type, team, and per-host count and duration limits) are bypassed for an authenticated user who has access through the existing event owner, host, assigned user, team admin or organization admin checks. Team- and organization-scoped keys are restricted to events in their stored team or organization. Otherwise this parameter is silently ignored. Only supported on the 2026-02-25 and 2026-05-01 API versions.

seat_uid.description: Uid of the specific seat within booking.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Reschedule a booking.

cancel_booking.title: Cancel a booking
cancel_booking.description: Cancel a booking and notify its attendees. Pass a recurring booking's uid to cancel every recurrence, or cancelSubsequentBookings to cancel one recurrence and those after it; for a seated booking pass seatUid to cancel only that seat. Not undoable.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

cancel_subsequent_bookings.description: For recurring non-seated booking only - if true, cancel booking with the bookingUid of the individual recurrence and all recurrences that come after it.

seat_uid.description: Uid of the specific seat within booking.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Cancel a booking.

mark_booking_absence.title: Mark a booking absence
mark_booking_absence.description: Mark a past booking's host and/or attendees as no-shows. `host` flags the host; `attendees` is a list of {email, absent}. Called as the booking owner.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Mark a booking absence.

reassign_booking.title: Reassign a booking
reassign_booking.description: Reassign a round-robin or managed event type booking to another host. Without userUuid an available round-robin host is picked automatically; with userUuid the booking goes to that user. Use reassign_booking_to_user to target a user by numeric id.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

user_uuid.description: UUID of the user to reassign the booking to. Omit it to let Cal.com pick an available round robin host. For a managed event booking, list the eligible users with `GET /v2/bookings/{bookingUid}/reassignment-candidates` and pass a candidate's `uuid`.

reason.description: Reason for reassigning the booking. Only recorded when `userUuid` is set.
reason.example: Host has to take another call

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Reassign a booking.

reassign_booking_to_user.title: Reassign a booking to a specific host
reassign_booking_to_user.description: Reassign a round-robin booking to a specific host by user id, optionally with a reason. Use reassign_booking to let Cal.com pick an available host.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

reason.example: Host has to take another call

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Reassign a booking to a specific host.

confirm_booking.title: Confirm a booking
confirm_booking.description: Accept a booking that is waiting for host confirmation (event types that require confirmation). Returns the confirmed booking. Use decline_booking to reject it.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Confirm a booking.

confirm_booking_seats.title: Confirm booking seats
confirm_booking_seats.description: Confirm selected seats (by seat uid) on a seated booking whose event type requires confirmation. Returns which seats were confirmed and which were already confirmed.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

seat_uids.description: Seat UIDs to confirm. A seat that is already confirmed stays confirmed. Duplicate UIDs in one request are confirmed once.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Confirm booking seats.

decline_booking_seats.title: Decline booking seats
decline_booking_seats.description: Decline selected seats (by seat uid) on a seated booking whose event type requires confirmation. The declined attendees are notified.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

seat_uids.description: Seat UIDs to decline. A waiting or confirmed seat becomes declined. A seat that is already declined stays declined. Duplicate UIDs in one request are declined once.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Decline booking seats.

decline_booking.title: Decline a booking
decline_booking.description: Reject a booking that is waiting for host confirmation, optionally with a reason sent to the attendee. Not undoable; use confirm_booking to accept instead.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

reason.description: Reason for declining a booking that requires a confirmation
reason.example: Host has to take another call

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Decline a booking.

request_booking_reschedule.title: Request to reschedule a booking
request_booking_reschedule.description: Ask the attendee to pick a new time: the booking is cancelled and the attendee is emailed a link to rebook, with an optional reason. Use reschedule_booking to move it yourself.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

reschedule_reason.description: Reason for requesting to reschedule the booking
reschedule_reason.example: I need to reschedule due to a conflict

output.description: The response envelope: `data` plus `status` (pass pagination.nextCursor back as cursor where the endpoint is cursor-paginated).

get_booking_calendar_links.title: Get 'Add to Calendar' links for a booking
get_booking_calendar_links.description: Return 'Add to calendar' links for a booking: Google Calendar, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Outlook and a downloadable ICS file.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get 'Add to Calendar' links for a booking.

get_booking_references.title: Get booking references
get_booking_references.description: List a booking's references: the external calendar events and video meetings created for it (type, uid, meeting id/URL, credential). Filter by reference type.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get booking references.

get_booking_conferencing_sessions.title: Get Video Meeting Sessions. Only supported for Cal Video
get_booking_conferencing_sessions.description: List the Cal Video meeting sessions of a booking: who joined, when and for how long. Only supported for Cal Video.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get Video Meeting Sessions. Only supported for Cal Video.

update_booking_location.title: Update booking location for an existing booking
update_booking_location.description: Change an existing booking's location (address, link, phone, or an integration such as Zoom, Google Meet or Cal Video). The calendar event is updated, a conference link is provisioned for integrations, and attendees are notified.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

location.description: One of the event type locations. If instead of passing one of the location objects as required by schema you are still passing a string please use an object. Fields: type*, address*, location*, phone*, integration*, link* (* = required).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Update booking location for an existing booking.

send_booking_email_verification_code.title: Send email verification code
send_booking_email_verification_code.description: Send a one-time verification code to an attendee email, for event types that require booker email verification. Pass the code to create_booking as emailVerificationCode, or check it with verify_booking_email_code.

event_type_id.description: Id of the event type being booked. When provided, the email honours the hide-branding setting of the event type's owner or team.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Send email verification code.

check_booking_email_verification_require.title: Check if email verification is required
check_booking_email_verification_require.description: Check whether booking with the given email requires email verification first. Returns true when a code must be sent with send_booking_email_verification_code.

output.description: The response body (status and, when present, data).

verify_booking_email_code.title: Verify email with code
verify_booking_email_code.description: Verify an attendee email with the one-time code sent by send_booking_email_verification_code. Returns whether the code was valid.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Verify email with code.

list_booking_attendees.title: Get all attendees for a booking
list_booking_attendees.description: List every attendee of a booking with id, name, email, time zone, phone number, language and absent flag.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get all attendees for a booking.

add_booking_attendee.title: Add an attendee to a booking
add_booking_attendee.description: Add an attendee (name, email, time zone, optional phone and language) to an existing non-seated booking and notify them. For seated events create another booking instead; use add_booking_guests for email-only guests.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the attendee.

phone_number.description: The phone number of the attendee in international format.

language.description: The preferred language of the attendee. Used for booking confirmation.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Add an attendee to a booking.

get_booking_attendee.title: Get a specific attendee for a booking
get_booking_attendee.description: Get one attendee of a booking by attendee id. Use list_booking_attendees to find the id.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get a specific attendee for a booking.

add_booking_guests.title: Add guests to an existing booking
add_booking_guests.description: Add up to 10 guests (email, optional name/time zone) to an existing non-seated booking, 30 guests per booking at most. Rate limited to 5 requests per minute. Guests receive the invitation.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

guests.description: Array of guests to add to the booking. Maximum 100 guests per request. Fields: email*, name, timeZone, phoneNumber, language (* = required).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Add guests to an existing booking.

get_booking_routing_trace.title: Get the routing trace for a booking
get_booking_routing_trace.description: Return the step-by-step routing trace of a booking: how routing forms, CRM lookups and host selection led to the assigned host, grouped by routing round.

booking_uid.description: Booking uid (the `uid` of a booking from list_bookings or get_booking).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get the routing trace for a booking.

get_calendar_event.title: Get meeting details from calendar
get_calendar_event.description: Get a meeting's details from the connected calendar provider (currently Google), including attendance metrics. `eventUid` is the provider event id from a booking reference.

calendar.description: Calendar provider: google, office365 or apple (as the endpoint allows).

event_uid.description: Provider event id of the meeting (from get_booking_references).

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Get meeting details from calendar.

update_calendar_event.title: Update meeting details in calendar
update_calendar_event.description: Update a meeting directly in the connected calendar provider (currently Google): start/end, title, description, attendees or status. Does not change the Cal.com booking; use reschedule_booking for that.

calendar.description: Calendar provider: google, office365 or apple (as the endpoint allows).

event_uid.description: Provider event id of the meeting (from get_booking_references).

start.description: Start date and time of the calendar event with timezone information Fields: time, timeZone (* = required).

end.description: End date and time of the calendar event with timezone information Fields: time, timeZone (* = required).

description.description: Detailed description of the calendar event

attendees.description: List of attendees. CAUTION: You must pass the entire array with all updated values. Any attendees not included in this array will be removed from the event. Fields: email, name, responseStatus, self, optional, host (* = required).

status.description: Status of the event (accepted, pending, declined, cancelled)

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Update meeting details in calendar.

save_ics_feed.title: Save an ICS feed
save_ics_feed.description: Connect one or more ICS feed URLs as a calendar so their events block availability. readOnly defaults to true. Returns the created credential.

read_only.description: Whether to allowing writing to the calendar or not

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Save an ICS feed.

check_ics_feed.title: Check an ICS feed
check_ics_feed.description: Check whether the authenticated user's ICS feed calendar connection is working.

output.description: The response body (status and, when present, data).

get_busy_times.title: Get busy times
get_busy_times.description: Get busy time ranges between dateFrom and dateTo from a connected calendar, in the given time zone. `calendar` is one calendar as `credentialId,externalId` (both returned by list_calendars). Use get_available_slots for bookable times.

time_zone.description: The timezone for the busy times query represented as a string

team_id.description: Team id, from list_teams (or list_org_teams inside an organization).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for cursor-based pagination. Pass the `pagination.nextCursor` value from a previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to fetch the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of Events to return.

slug.description: Filter by the event's public page slug (cal.com/{slug}).

status.description: Filter events by lifecycle status. `draft`: not published and not cancelled, ordered soonest first. `upcoming`: published and not yet ended, or cancelled but not yet started, ordered soonest first. `past`: everything else, ordered latest first. create_team_event.description: Create a draft Event owned by a team: title, startTime, endTime, timeZone plus optional settings. Publish it with publish_event.

team_id.description: Team id, from list_teams (or list_org_teams inside an organization).

start_time.description: When the Event starts, in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone. It must not be in the past.

end_time.description: When the Event ends, in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone. It must be after `startTime`.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the Event's times are shown in.

slug.description: Public page slug (cal.com/{slug}): 10-100 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Generated from the title when omitted.

description.description: What the Event is about, shown on its page.

visibility.description: Once published: PUBLIC is listed on the owner's page, UNLISTED only opens from its link. Defaults to PUBLIC.

capacity.description: The most guests the Event can take. Omit or pass null for unlimited. Ignored once any location has its own `capacity`: the Event then takes the sum of the location capacities, or is unlimited if any location has none. The waitlist only opens when the Event or the chosen location is full, so it only works when capacity is set on the Event or on a location.

waitlist_enabled.description: Let guests join a waitlist when the Event is full. The waitlist only opens when the Event or the chosen location is full, so it only works when capacity is set on the Event or on a location.

payment_timeout_minutes.description: How many minutes a guest's seat is held while they pay. null uses the default of 10 minutes.

registration_opens_at.description: When guests can start registering, in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone. Must be before registration closes. null opens registration when the Event is published.

registration_closes_at.description: When registration closes, in ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone. Must not be after `startTime`. null closes registration when the Event starts. Guests already on the waitlist can still be promoted after it closes.

requires_approval.description: Registrations wait for a host's approval.

show_organizer_email.description: Show the organizer's email to guests.

guest_list.description: Who guests can see on the Event's page. `names` lists them, `count` shows how many, `hidden` shows neither. Defaults to `names`.

show_presented_by.description: Show who the Event is presented by.

theme.description: Default theme of the event page. null follows the visitor's system setting.

background.description: Animated background of the event page. Fields: effect*, colors* (* = required).

lineup.description: Speakers or performers on the event page. Avatars need the Event uuid, so create people without avatarUrl and upload avatars with the person avatar endpoint afterwards. Fields: title, people* (* = required).

schedule.description: Agenda on the event page. Each item has either a startTime or a timeLabel. Avatars need the Event uuid, so create people without avatarUrl and upload avatars with the person avatar endpoint afterwards. Fields: startTime, endTime, timeLabel, content*, people (* = required).

registration_fields.description: The questions guests answer when they register. Fields: field*, slug, variant*, label, placeholder, disableOnPrefill, firstNameLabel, firstNamePlaceholder, lastNameLabel, lastNamePlaceholder, lastNameRequired, required, hidden, excludeEmails, requireEmails, type*, minLength, maxLength, options* (* = required).

live_streams.description: Links where people can watch the event live. Fields: url* (* = required).

category.description: What kind of event it is. If not passed, it's guessed from the title.

price.description: Price of the Event, in the currency's smallest unit. Only for Events without locations, which need at least one live stream; Events with locations are priced per location. On update, null makes the Event free. Check `paymentsEnabled` on the Event before setting it.

currency.description: Cal Pay currency code. Required when `price` is set.

locations.description: Where the Event happens. Links can repeat. An Event can have one address and one conferencing location, either an integration or the organizer's default app. Fields: label, price, currency, capacity, type*, address*, link*, integration*, credentialId (* = required).

booking_limits_duration.description: Limit total amount of time that this event can be booked Fields: day, week, month, year, disabled (* = required).

show_optimized_slots.description: Arrange time slots to optimize availability.

create_org_team_routing_form_response.title: Create routing form response and get available slots
create_org_team_routing_form_response.description: Submit a response to an organization team routing form and get the routed event type with available slots between start and end.
create_org_team_routing_form_response.notes: The reference gives no schema for this request body; the answers are sent as the JSON body, a map of routing form field identifier to answer, the same shape calculate_routing_form_slots takes.

org_id.description: Organization id (the organizationId returned by get_me).

team_id.description: Team id, from list_teams (or list_org_teams inside an organization).

start.description: Time starting from which available slots should be checked. Must be in UTC timezone as ISO 8601 datestring. You can pass date without hours which defaults to start of day or specify hours: 2024-08-13 (will have hours 00:00:00 aka at very beginning of the date) or you can specify hours manually like 2024-08-13T09:00:00Z

end.description: Time until which available slots should be checked. Must be in UTC timezone as ISO 8601 datestring. You can pass date without hours which defaults to end of day or specify hours: 2024-08-20 (will have hours 23:59:59 aka at the very end of the date) or you can specify hours manually like 2024-08-20T18:00:00Z

time_zone.description: Time zone in which the available slots should be returned. Defaults to UTC.

duration.description: If event type has multiple possible durations then you can specify the desired duration here. Also, if you are fetching slots for a dynamic event then you can specify the duration her which defaults to 30, meaning that returned slots will be each 30 minutes long.

format.description: Format of slot times in response. Use 'range' to get start and end times.

booking_uid_to_reschedule.description: The unique identifier of the booking being rescheduled. When provided will ensure that the original booking time appears within the returned available slots when rescheduling.

reschedule_with_same_host.description: Only for round robin event types that allow the person rescheduling to choose the host. True returns slots of the original host, false returns slots of any available host. Ignored for other event types.

queue_response.description: Whether to queue the form response.

responses.description: The routing form answers: a map of form field identifier to answer, using option labels rather than option ids, e.g. {"email": "jane@example.com", "department": "sales"}. Must not be empty.

output.description: The `data` payload of the response: Create routing form response and get available slots.

event_type_id.description: Event type id, from list_event_types or the team event type listings.

calendar_invites.description: Write-only host and guest calendar-invite description settings. These are saved separately from the event type and are not returned by event-type read endpoints. Fields: host, guest (* = required).

length_in_minutes_options.description: If you want that user can choose between different lengths of the event you can specify them here. Must include the provided `lengthInMinutes`.

description.example: Discover the culinary wonders of the Argentina by making the best flan ever!

slot_interval.description: Number representing length of each slot when event is booked. By default it equal length of the event type. If event length is 60 minutes then we would have slots 9AM, 10AM, 11AM etc. but if it was changed to 30 minutes then we would have slots 9AM, 9:30AM, 10AM, 10:30AM etc. as the available times to book the 60 minute event.

minimum_booking_notice.description: Minimum number of minutes before the event that a booking can be made.

before_event_buffer.description: Extra time automatically blocked on your calendar before a meeting starts. This gives you time to prepare, review notes, or transition from your previous activity.

after_event_buffer.description: Extra time automatically blocked on your calendar after a meeting ends. This gives you time to wrap up, add notes, or decompress before your next commitment.

schedule_id.description: If you want that this event has different schedule than user's default one you can specify it here.

booking_limits_count.description: Limit how many times this event can be booked Fields: day, week, month, year, disabled* (* = required).

booker_active_bookings_limit.description: Limit the number of active bookings a booker can make for this event type. Fields: maximumActiveBookings, offerReschedule, disabled (* = required).

only_show_first_available_slot.description: This will limit your availability for this event type to one slot per day, scheduled at the earliest available time.

booking_limits_duration.description: Limit total amount of time that this event can be booked Fields: day, week, month, year, disabled (* = required).

booking_window.description: Limit how far in the future this event can be booked Fields: type*, value*, rolling, disabled (* = required).

offset_start.description: Offset timeslots shown to bookers by a specified number of minutes

booker_layouts.description: Should booker have week, month or column view. Specify default layout and enabled layouts user can pick. Fields: defaultLayout*, enabledLayouts* (* = required).

confirmation_policy.description: Specify how the booking needs to be manually confirmed before it is pushed to the integrations and a confirmation mail is sent. Fields: type*, noticeThreshold, blockUnconfirmedBookingsInBooker*, disabled (* = required).

booking_proposal_count.description: Maximum number of timeslots a proposal may include. The client chooses from 1 through this maximum. Set to null to use the default single-slot booking flow.

recurrence.description: Create a recurring event type. Fields: interval*, occurrences*, frequency*, disabled (* = required).

skip_attendee_email_deliverability_check.description: When true, skips the MX deliverability check for attendee emails on booking. Format validation and watchlist still apply. Requires the editor to belong to an organization (including platform orgs).

email_settings.description: Email settings for this event type. Personal event types require an accepted organization membership; team event types require an organization team. This does not include emails sent by custom email workflows. Fields: disableEmailsToAttendees, disableEmailsToHosts, disableProposalEmailsToHosts (* = required).

lock_time_zone_toggle_on_booking_page.description: Lock time zone toggle on booking page.

seats.description: Create an event type with multiple seats. Fields: seatsPerTimeSlot*, showAttendeeInfo*, showAvailabilityCount*, disabled (* = required).

custom_name.description: Customizable event name with valid variables: {Link title}, {Event type title} (legacy), {Organiser}, {Scheduler}, {Location}, {Organiser first name}, {Scheduler first name}, {Scheduler last name}, {Event duration}, {LOCATION}, {HOST/ATTENDEE}, {HOST}, {ATTENDEE}, {USER}

success_redirect_url.description: A valid URL where the booker will redirect to, once the booking is completed successfully

hide_organizer_email.description: Boolean to Hide organizer's email address from the booking screen, email notifications, and calendar events

cal_video_settings.description: Cal video settings for the event type Fields: disableRecordingForOrganizer, disableRecordingForGuests, redirectUrlOnExit, enableAutomaticRecordingForOrganizer, enableAutomaticTranscription, disableTranscriptionForGuests, disableTranscriptionForOrganizer, hideTranscriptionForGuests, hideTranscriptionForOrganizer, sendTranscriptionEmails, disableAttendeeRecordingDownloadEmail, transcriptionLanguage (* = required).

booking_requires_authentication.description: Boolean to require authentication for booking this event type via api. If true, only authenticated users who are the event-type owner or org/team admin/owner can book this event type.

disable_cancelling.description: Settings for disabling cancelling of this event type. Fields: disabled (* = required).

disable_rescheduling.description: Settings for disabling rescheduling of this event type. Can be always disabled or disabled when less than X minutes before the meeting. Fields: disabled, minutesBefore (* = required).

interface_language.description: Set preferred language for the booking interface. Use empty string for visitor's browser language (default).

week_start.description: Day the booking page calendar starts the week on. Overrides the host's account setting for this event type only. Omit or set to null to inherit the account setting.

allow_rescheduling_past_bookings.description: Enabling this option allows for past events to be rescheduled.

allow_rescheduling_cancelled_bookings.description: When enabled, users will be able to create a new booking when trying to reschedule a cancelled booking.

show_optimized_slots.description: Arrange time slots to optimize availability.

use_isolated_availability.description: When true, only this event type's own Cal.com bookings block the slot. The availability schedule and connected calendars still apply. Same as "Consider only this booking link's bookings" in the web app. Requires an organization with at least 15 members.

private_note_enabled.description: When enabled, a private note calendar event is created alongside the booking with the resolved template as its description. Only visible to the host.

private_note_mode.description: How private notes are delivered: as an additional host event or by sending separate host and guest invites.

private_note_template.description: Template for the private note content. Supports variables like {Attendee name}, {Link title}, {Event type title} (legacy), {Location}, {Host name}, {Event duration}, and custom booking field names.

allow_affecting_upcoming_bookings.description: Allows this update to affect upcoming bookings when a live confirmation session exists. Not stored and not returned. `true` confirms the edit: - Turning seats off cancels every attendee and booking attempt, and new bookings are taken one at a time. - Turning confirmation off rejects pending requests, leaves accepted attendees, and confirms new booking attempts until the seats are full.

scheduling_type.description: The scheduling type for the team event - collective or roundRobin. ❗If you change scheduling type you must also provide `hosts` or `assignAllTeamMembers` in the request body, otherwise the event type will have no hosts - this is required because in case of collective event type all hosts are mandatory but in case of round robin some or non can be mandatory so we can't predict how you want the hosts to be setup which is why you must provide that i...

hosts.description: Hosts contain specific team members you want to assign to this event type. To assign every current and future team member use `assignAllTeamMembers: true` and omit this field. Fields: userId*, mandatory, priority, weight (* = required).

assign_all_team_members.description: If true, all current and future team members will be assigned to this event type. Mutually exclusive with `hosts` for collective and managed event types. For round robin event types, `hosts` may be provided alongside `assignAllTeamMembers: true` solely to designate fixed hosts via `mandatory: true` entries.

locations.description: Locations where the event will take place. If not provided, cal video link will be used as the location. Note: Setting a location to a conferencing app does not install the app - the app must already be installed. Via API, only Google Meet (google-meet), Microsoft Teams (office365-video), and Zoom (zoom) can be installed. Cal Video (cal-video) is installed by default. Fields: type*, address*, public*, link*, integration*, phone* (* = required).

reschedule_with_same_round_robin_host.description: Rescheduled events will be assigned to the same host as initially scheduled.

allow_rrhost_choice_on_reschedule.description: Let the person rescheduling choose between keeping the original host and letting round robin pick from the whole team. Requires rescheduleWithSameRoundRobinHost to be enabled.

is_rrweights_enabled.description: Only relevant for round robin event types. If true, bookings are distributed according to each host's `weight` instead of evenly.

booking_fields.description: Booking fields for the event type. Omit this property to keep the current fields. Provide an array to replace them, customize default fields, or add custom booking fields. At least one of `email` or `attendeePhoneNumber` must be visible and required. The array cannot be empty, contain duplicate default fields or custom slugs, or use a default field's slug for a custom field. Omitted default fields are restored with their default settings. Fields: field*, slug, variant*, label, placeholder, disableOnPrefill, firstNameLabel, firstNamePlaceholder, lastNameLabel, lastNamePlaceholder, lastNameRequired, required, hidden, excludeEmails, requireEmails, type*, minLength, maxLength, options* (* = required).

crm.description: CRM app settings for the event type, mirroring the event type Apps tab toggles. The credential is resolved server-side — the app must be installed for the event type owner. Fields: hubspot, salesforce (* = required).
